pptxToVideoPipeline.architecture: A1 Hybrid 16:9 Visual Master PNG background + A2 Native Editable OOXML text/card overlays + AI Explainer Speaker Notes
pptxToVideoPipeline.authoritativePngSyncRule: Use work/design/decks/<deckId>/slides/Slide1.PNG..SlideN.PNG sorted numerically (Slide10.PNG after Slide9.PNG); never extract frames from MP4 or use FFmpeg zoompan.

kinematicLifecycle.name: Spring Entrance
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Translate card stage from -280px -> 0px with spring(damping: 18, stiffness: 120, mass: 0.9)

kinematicLifecycle.name: Sub-Pixel Bezier Drift
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Continuous ~42px camera drift inside 1,152px overscan bleed margin (0px black edge)

kinematicLifecycle.name: Focal ROI Push-In
kinematicLifecycle.rule: 1.08x smooth push-in onto active card, stat counter, or code block ROI

kinematicLifecycle.name: Momentum Exit
kinematicLifecycle.rule: Translate card stage to +380px while EnvironmentalBackground and root vignette stay anchored

layouts.name: 01 · Landing Hero
layouts.cameraMotion: 1.35x decoupled background plate + 6% slow Z-axis push-in over slide duration; fixed root vignette (zIndex: 5)

elementChoreography.headline: Frames 6..22: 110-120pt hero spring entrance (damping: 18, stiffness: 120) + double-pass dark drop shadow on (h1, h2, .title)
elementChoreography.subtitle: Frames 14..28: smooth fade-up + acoustic karaoke word-highlight tracking on (.lede, .lede, .subtitle, p)
elementChoreography.badges: Frames 20..36: 4-frame staggered pop-in with triple-pass physical drop-shadow on (.pill, .badge, .tag, .synth-badge)

layouts.hyperframesGsap: tl.from(".eyebrow, .kicker, .eyebrow, .synth-kicker", { y: 18, opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power3.out" }, 0).from("h1, h2, .title", { y: 36, scale: 0.94, opacity: 0, duration: 0.55, ease: "back.out(1.4)" }, 0.12).from(".lede, .lede, .subtitle, p", { y: 20, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45 }, 0.28).from(".pill, .badge, .tag, .synth-badge", { scale: 0.85, opacity: 0, stagger: 0.08, duration: 0.35 }, 0.42);

layouts.name: 02 · Feature Grid
layouts.cameraMotion: 4-phase kinematic lifecycle: spring entrance (-280px -> 0), bezier drift (+42px), 1.06x card ROI focus, momentum exit (+380px)

elementChoreography.headline: Frames 4..18: 96pt headline spring entrance on (h1, h2, .title)
elementChoreography.cards: Frames 10..36: multi-column card stagger (4 frames per card) with active-card border highlight on (.card, .synth-card, [class*="card"])
elementChoreography.subtitle: Continuous: acoustic word-by-word karaoke highlight striking on (.lede, .lede, .subtitle, p)

layouts.hyperframesGsap: tl.from(".eyebrow, .kicker, .eyebrow, .synth-kicker", { y: 14, opacity: 0, duration: 0.3 }, 0).from("h1, h2, .title", { y: 28, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.1).from(".card, .synth-card, [class*="card"]", { y: 36, opacity: 0, stagger: 0.1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.22);
layouts.transitionOut: Momentum exit (+380px) with anchored background plate
